notes: This manifest is for external validation suites only.
READoc is the first recommended external suite because it is document-level PDF -> Markdown and aligns with the local_structured_pdf pipeline.
Keep opendataloader-bench as the final scoring gate; use external suites to shape general heuristics.

suites.description: Small READoc arXiv sample built from direct PDF downloads and GT markdown.
